name: French Valley to Mirador Británico
region: Torres del Paine National Park, centre
why: Into the heart of the massif: avalanches off the Paine Grande glacier, then an amphitheatre of granite at the top.
book: Catamaran Pudeto–Paine Grande (pay on board in cash or card; no booking). The park entry ticket online.
dangers: The upper valley is closed by rangers in strong wind or late in the day.
A long day: the catamaran back has fixed times.
turnaround: Leave Mirador Británico by 15:00 to catch the last catamaran from Paine Grande.

points.name: Refugio Paine Grande on Lago Pehoé
points.note: Off the catamaran from Pudeto. East along Lago Skottsberg for 2 h.

points.name: Campamento Italiano
points.note: Leave anything heavy at the ranger post; the valley climbs from here.

points.name: Mirador Francés
points.note: Under the hanging glacier of Paine Grande: listen for the avalanches.

points.name: Mirador Británico
points.note: About 1,100 m: the ring of towers, from the Cuernos to Fortaleza.
